**Finding submitted: deviation (Section 8.2, ¶p0492).**

- **What the clause does:** Section 8.2 "Exclusivity of Efforts" bars Ono (and Array) from Commercializing a "Competing Product" — a product whose API is a MEK- or BRAF-type inhibitor other than Binimetinib/Encorafenib — in the Ono Territory.
- **Acceptable part:** The first sentence is mutual, term-limited, confined to Commercialization in our own territory, and equally binds Array. That is part of the license bargain and benefits us, so we did not touch it.
- **The problem:** The second sentence is a one-way post-termination non-compete on Ono only, running to an unspecified "[ * ] anniversary" of termination and triggered even when Ono terminates at will. That fails the fallback (term-only, 12-month cap) and, for any tail beyond 12 months, is walk-away territory.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** Deleted the post-term tail sentence, leaving the mutual during-term exclusivity, the royalty-relief mechanic and Array's termination right intact — the smallest edit reaching the preferred position, with a 12-month tail plus internal-development/acquisition carve-outs offered as fallback in the comment.
